display_exchanges.purpose: Build a new document-first specialist letter prototype from blank and establish its complete review-and-export workflow.
display_exchanges.exact_prompt: Build entirely NEW from blank standalone /workspace/scratch/511edc76527a/referralflow-fresh/dist/A.html. Do not read any other prior html, prototypes, site or backup anywhere. User expressly forbids existing prototypes influencing this build. This is prompt A1 of 5 actual AI development exchanges; log exact text with purpose/result/time in /workspace/scratch/511edc76527a/referralflow-fresh/logs/A.json; attribute AI assistant → coding agent, no invented student authorship. Product ReferralFlow AI, team Dental Demand Labs, MENG570 assignment requires 3 distinct functional interactive prototypes each testing hypothesis & prior persona. A persona Dr. Arjun Patel owner-periodontist. Fixed concept: existing specialist notes → draft referral report → specialist edits/reviews/confirms recipient/approves → export to existing authorized channel. No autonomous sending. Use ONLY fictional data and label demo. Meaningful controls: load fictional note, generate local deterministic letter from structured labeled notes (not real AI), edit letter, confirm review and recipient, approve then TXT export frozen snapshot, edit again invalidates approval. Expose clean window.demo API for Node VM state tests. All app code self-contained. Need top-tier usable functional UI.
